flavor: A collection of delicate, translucent sculptures shaped like leaping foxes and soaring hawks stands atop pedestals of cooling basalt. The air shimmers with a dry, intense heat, and the scent of ozone lingers near the center of the chamber.
name: The Cinder-Glass Menagerie
reason: The room serves as a gallery for a master artisan who used elemental fire to flash-freeze molten sand into intricate, permanent shapes.
